name: King EX85
description: King EX85 by The Disk King: Inspired by the Akai EX85P parametric equalizer (1987). Four bands with Akai's own figures: LOW shelf at 40 Hz (+-14 dB, Q 0.5), sweepable MID LOW (60 Hz-5 kHz) and MID HI (100 Hz-10 kHz) at +-18 dB, HI shelf at 12 kHz (+-14 dB, Q 0.5), the dual BAND WIDTH knob (its own Q for each mid, 1 to 6), EFFECT in/out switch.
author: The Disk King
